newsitem.title: UK: UK shares hit record high as Wall Street gains.
newsitem.headline: UK shares hit record high as Wall Street gains.

text.p: Britain's FTSE 100 index leapt to a record high in late Friday trading, echoing buoyant U.S. markets as weak U.S. jobs figures gave further evidence of an economic slowdown and eased pressure for higher U.S. interest rates.
The index broke through the previous peak of 4,024.3 set on Thursday to reach a new intraday high of 4,025.1, up 25.1 points on the day. It later closed up 24.8 points at a record 4,024.8.

After a week in which the FTSE has set a series of records, weaker-than-expected U.S. employment data allayed fears the world's biggest economy was growing fast enough to prompt higher U.S. rates -- which set a benchmark for rates round the world.
